title: Repair the Windows Update database
description: Use DISM to repair corrupted Windows Update components

examples.description: Standard run of the command. See the official documentation with Get-Help DISM -Full for the available parameters and advanced uses.

notes: ⏱️ Can take 15-30 minutes depending on the speed of the PC and of the Internet connection. Requires administrator rights.
